source.author: verg
source.text: Quocirca capere ante dolis et cingere flamma reginam meditor, ne quo se numine mutet, sed magno Aeneae mecum teneatur amore.
source.text_original: Quocirca capere ante dolis et cingere flamma / reginam meditor, ne quo se numine mutet, / sed magno Aeneae mecum teneatur amore.
source.text_english: Accordingly, I am planning first to ensnare the queen by trickery and surround her with fire, lest she somehow change herself by some divine power, but that she may be held with me by a great love for Aeneas.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: quodsi filios habuerit, redditur suboli suae, ut iuxta apostolum his ministretur, quae uere uidua sunt, et ut, quae sacerdotalibus sustentatur cibis, nullius alterius amore teneatur.
reuse.text_original: quodsi filios habuerit, redditur suboli suae, ut iuxta apostolum his ministretur, quae uere uidua sunt, et ut, quae sacerdotalibus sustentatur cibis, nullius alterius amore teneatur.
reuse.text_english: But if she has children, she is given back to her offspring, so that, according to the Apostle, provision may be made for those who are truly widows, and so that she, who is supported by priestly food, may not be held by love for anyone else.
